violations.text: No person certified in food safety was present at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (various cheeses) in the open case cooler. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

(Sliced ham and cheeses) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table shelves and all refrigeration units ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment, and clutter were observed in the (back storage) areas. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Bucket used for prepping chicken were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

Pastillitos was observed held at (119) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC reheated to proper temperature. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

The door to the outside, located in the back storage(garage), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024
Bag of avocados were observed stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (quaternary) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 06/14/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024
